origin: Researcher-designed, 2026-09-23, after deep external research per user's 'think out of the box' instruction. Distinct from every prior scalping attempt in this project: based on concrete recent price structure (swing highs/lows) rather than a statistical rolling-average threshold.
thesis: A documented retail/institutional pattern: price briefly wicks through a resting liquidity level (a recent swing high/low, where stop-losses and pending orders cluster) before reversing, because the move was a liquidity grab rather than a genuine breakout. Detected as: a bar's high/low clears a recent (SwingLookback bars) swing level by at least MinSweepPips, but its close rejects back inside the prior range.

entry.trigger: bearish sweep (high > recent swing high + MinSweepPips, close < swing high) -> sell; bullish sweep (low < recent swing low - MinSweepPips, close > swing low) -> buy
skip_conditions: computed lot size below broker minimum

stop_loss: beyond the sweep bar's extreme (high + StopBufferPips for shorts, low - StopBufferPips for longs)

exit.rule: market close MaxHoldMinutes after entry if SL/TP not hit, or immediately at session end (18:00 server)

tunable_parameters_to_sweep: SwingLookback, MinSweepPips, StopBufferPips, TPMultiplier -- not yet swept, v1 baseline uses reasonable starting defaults.
